arguments.query:
SELECT time, pid, ppid, pname, process_name, process_guid, command_line, parent_process_name, parent_process_path, parent_command_line, parent_process_guid, access, object, source_stream, event_record_id, event_id, source_row_id, original_table, childproc_name, filemod_name, regmod_name, netconn_domain, remote_ip, remote_port, alert_name, alert_reason, alert_category, raw_event_type
FROM audit_logs
WHERE time BETWEEN '2022-07-19 14:31:00' AND '2022-07-19 14:36:00'
  AND (
    lower(coalesce(pname,'')) LIKE '%winword.exe%'
    OR lower(coalesce(process_name,'')) LIKE '%winword.exe%'
    OR (lower(coalesce(object,'')) LIKE '%winword.exe%' AND (access IN ('execute','process_create') OR event_id IN (4688,1)))
    OR (lower(coalesce(childproc_name,'')) LIKE '%winword.exe%')
  )
ORDER BY time, event_record_id
LIMIT 30;

SELECT
  pid, ppid, process_guid,
  group_concat(DISTINCT childproc_name) AS childproc_name_values,
  group_concat(DISTINCT filemod_name) AS filemod_name_values,
  group_concat(DISTINCT regmod_name) AS regmod_name_values,
  group_concat(DISTINCT netconn_domain) AS netconn_domain_values,
  group_concat(DISTINCT remote_ip) AS remote_ip_values,
  group_concat(DISTINCT remote_port) AS remote_port_values,
  group_concat(DISTINCT CASE WHEN alert_name IS NOT NULL OR alert_reason IS NOT NULL OR alert_category IS NOT NULL THEN source_stream || ':' || coalesce(source_row_id,event_record_id) || ':' || coalesce(alert_name,'') || ':' || coalesce(alert_reason,'') || ':' || coalesce(alert_category,'') END) AS cbc_alert_rows,

FROM audit_logs
WHERE time BETWEEN '2022-07-19 14:31:00' AND '2022-07-19 14:36:00'
  AND (
    pid IN (5592,1604)
    OR process_guid = '{558F98EB-C0AD-62D6-0101-000000003B00}'
